headline: Deere (DE) Stock May Be Below Fair Value As Contract Talks Drag On
summary: Deere stock has delivered strong returns over the past few years, yet current valuation checks and an intrinsic value estimate using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach both suggest the shares trade at a discount to that intrinsic value, even with a relatively low overall value score. Deere has returned 72.7% over the past 5 years, which puts extra focus on whether the current share price still leaves room for further long term value.
